description: Implementation of DocumentDao interface using JDBC for directory and file management, including create, delete, find, and update operations.

classes.name: DocumentDaoImpl
classes.description: JDBC-based implementation of DocumentDao for managing directory and file entities.

methods.name: obtainPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves the last generated primary key within a transaction.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Directory or File record in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a File record from the database.

methods.name: getDirectoryWithImmediateParentPopulated
methods.description: Recursively loads a Directory with its immediate parent populated.

methods.name: findElements
methods.description: Finds and returns elements (directories and files) within a specified directory.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the content of a File record.
